field_prompts.label: Title
field_prompts.prompt: Which title would you like to reserve?

field_prompts.label: Pickup date
field_prompts.prompt: On which date will you collect it?

field_prompts.label: Note for the desk
field_prompts.prompt: Is there anything the desk should know?

clarifications.prompt: I found more than one match for {input.title}. Which one do you mean?

corrections.acknowledgement: Got it, I updated the reservation details.
corrections.prepared_action_invalidated: I changed the details, so the earlier summary no longer applies. Here is the new one.

cancellations.acknowledgement: Okay, I did not reserve anything.

confirmations.request: Please confirm: reserve {reservation.title} at {reservation.branch} for pickup on {reservation.pickup_date}. Shall I go ahead?
confirmations.expired: That summary has expired, so nothing was reserved. Tell me again if you still want it.

success.text: Reserved: {reservation.title}, to collect on {reservation.pickup_date}. Your reference is {reservation.reference}.

failures.text: You are not allowed to reserve at this branch, so nothing was reserved.
That pickup date is not possible: it must be between today and 60 days ahead. Nothing was reserved.
No copy of {reservation.title} is free on {reservation.pickup_date}, so nothing was reserved.
{reservation.title} changed while we were talking, so nothing was reserved. I can prepare it again.
That reservation was not confirmed in time, so nothing was reserved.
I could not confirm whether the reservation was made. I will check its status before doing anything else, so it cannot be made twice.
